title: Find Minimum and Maximum Element
description: Given an array of integers `nums`, determine the maximum contiguous subarray sum (Kadane's algorithm variation). If all elements are negative, return the maximum single element.
outputFormat: Single integer representing maximum contiguous sum.
constraints: Elements are within standard placement ranges
solution:
def solve(nums):
    max_so_far = nums[0]
    curr_max = nums[0]
    for x in nums[1:]:
        curr_max = max(x, curr_max + x)
        max_so_far = max(max_so_far, curr_max)
    return max_so_far
hints: Consider edge cases like empty inputs or single element arrays.
Think about whether a two-pointer or hashing approach reduces complexity.
explanation: The optimal approach uses standard Arrays techniques to process the inputs in linear or logarithmic time complexity.
